messages:
Maya: Quick flag 1: onboarding notebook + runtime guide link to observability/tracing#span-ids returns 404 in prod docs. Page loads but the fragment is gone.
Ben: I can repro on Firefox and Chrome. Looks like the section header was changed to `Trace IDs` in the last edit, so old fragment `span-ids` no longer exists.
Maya: Ugh. That anchor is referenced from a few examples and a tutorial notebook used in the new-hire flow. We should add a compatibility alias so external links don't break.
Lena: Two options: add an HTML anchor near the new heading (fast) or add a frontmatter `aliases` entry (preferred for static site redirects). Frontmatter is reversible and plays nicer with autogenerated TOC.
Ben: I'll open a tiny PR to add frontmatter aliases and sweep internal refs. Running ripgrep found 4 hits: `handbook/onboarding/notebook.ipynb`, `runtime/examples/tracing.md`, `examples/observability/demo.ipynb`, and `scripts/ci/link-test.sh`.
Carlos: If you're doing a mass update, here's a tested perl one-liner that adds an aliases block right after frontmatter start. Drop into CI or run locally: 

```
perl -0777 -pe 's/^(---\n)(.*?)(\n---)/$1$2\naliases:\n  - "\/observability\/tracing#span-ids"\n$3/s' -i observability/tracing.md
```
Ben: Nice, thanks Carlos. I'll include that in the PR description and use rg+sed in the CI job to patch any stray hard-coded fragments.
Maya: Can we also add a small test in `examples/observability/demo.ipynb` that validates a fetch to the doc+fragment resolves (status 200 + fragment present)? That'll catch regressions during content refactors.
Lena: I'll pay attention to any client-side router quirks (fragment handling) during CR. If the site JS rewrites anchors we might need a tiny script to emit the HTML anchor as well.
Ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2389 1 - frontmatter alias + updated refs + demo notebook test. Pinging @Lena for review.
docs-bot: Link-checker triggered for PR 2389 :hourglass_flowing_sand: 1 - will post results here.
Ben: Assigned follow-ups to myself for 72h to monitor CI & onboarding notebook green status. Will revert to docs owners after merge. :rocket:
Maya: Thanks all. Add a changelog line like `docs: add alias for observability tracing old fragment (#2389)` so QA knows this was intentional.
Lena: LGTM for fast-track review once link-check passes.
